server.description: Autodesk Fusion 360's MCP server (its add-in), relayed: read the active 3D model, execute an operation in it, undo one; where it listens is a setting
server.instructions: Fusion 360's own MCP server, relayed through this slot. status says whether Fusion answers and where; tools lists what it exposes; call runs one of them by name; Fusion's tools are also mirrored here under their own names when Fusion answered at start. Nothing here is simulated: an operation executed changes the model open in Fusion.

status.title: Where Fusion is, and whether it answers
status.description: Where Fusion 360's MCP server is expected (its address, a setting: FUSION_MCP_URL, or connect {url}), whether it answers, what it said it is, and the tools it listed.

connect.title: Open the session with Fusion, here or elsewhere
connect.description: Opens (or reopens) the session with Fusion's MCP server; with url, on another address (another machine, another port, another CAD on the same protocol), kept until the server restarts.

properties.url: the streamable HTTP endpoint, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:27182/mcp; the current one when absent

tools.title: What Fusion exposes
tools.description: The tools Fusion's MCP server exposes, with their descriptions and input schemas, as it lists them now.

call.title: One of Fusion's tools, by name
call.description: Calls one tool of Fusion's MCP server by name with its arguments (tools says which and with what); the answer is Fusion's, parsed when it is JSON. Refused with Fusion's words when Fusion refuses.

properties.name: the tool, as tools lists it

resources.title: Fusion's resources
resources.description: The resources Fusion's MCP server exposes (the schemas of its entities, fields and filters), by URI.

resource.title: One of Fusion's resources
resource.description: Reads one resource of Fusion's MCP server by its URI (resources lists them); JSON is parsed.

properties.resourceUri: the resource's URI, as resources lists it

fusion://status.name: Fusion's MCP server, as this slot sees it
fusion://status.description: The endpoint in use (a setting), whether it answered, what it said it is, the tools it listed, the calls relayed
